name: How do I choose the right size bathroom vanity for my space?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right size bathroom vanity for my space?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right size bathroom vanity involves measuring your bathroom's available space accurately, considering both width and depth, especially if it's a tight area or near a door. Allow adequate clearance for door swings and traffic flow. Consider the existing plumbing rough-in locations, as altering them can increase costs. The vanity should be proportionate to the bathroom's overall size; a large vanity in a small bathroom can overwhelm the space, while a too-small vanity in a large bathroom can look out of place. Think about your storage needs and the desired sink configuration (single or double).
acceptedAnswer.description: Measure your space, consider plumbing, ensure proper clearance, and match the vanity's size to your bathroom's proportions and storage needs.
